title: 第13章 无意学得九式剑神秘龙字图第14章 元胎之气品质提升剑道二境
content_zh:
屋檐下，莫晚云一双眼睛好奇地打量这一处僻静小院，小院比她想象中的要好许多，有井，有一块灵田，最重要的是，还有一只看起来非常可爱的小木虎。
“哈，我坐小脑斧！”
莫晚云一下被那可爱的四脚木虎吸引，蹦跳着骑上去，两只玉手摇晃着木虎头上的犄角。
“小泥鳅，这个好玩。”
顾余生打量着那小木虎上的莫姑娘，小心翼翼的靠近护着。
“小心些，别弄坏了。”
莫晚云冷哼一声。
“小气。”
顾余生也不解释，转身走进屋，用竹篮摆放几块桃花饼，端一杯竹筒浸泡的桃花蜜酿，走到小木虎前，问道：
“莫姑娘，吃吗？”
莫晚云点点头，尝一口桃花饼，有些噎着，顺手拿起桃花蜜酿抿了一口，小手一抹嘴。
“喂，顾余生，这就是你待客的东西啊。”
顾余生从竹篮里取一块饼细细的咀嚼，说道：“这是我这里最好的了，当然，莫姑娘是个金贵的人，自然是吃不惯的，好在你也不是我，用不着吃这样的苦。”
说完。
顾余生重新紧握木剑，对着小院的桃花刺剑。
莫晚云扁了扁嘴，打量一会雨中少年刺剑的背影，扁了扁嘴，收回眸光，凝视着手中桃花饼以及桃花蜜酿。
她想要对少年说其实这饼和蜜酿都不错。
可她见少年专注，反倒自己被冷落一旁，置气般放下手中饼，嘀咕道：“你就非得这样练剑啊？下着雨嗳。”
少年回头，笑着道：“习惯了，倘若今日差一剑，明日就得罚自己一百剑，这样算下来，还是每日完成比较划算一些，莫姑娘请自便。”
“无聊。”

莫晚云见斜雨吹打在少年执拗的脸庞上，他手上的每一剑都并非是敷衍般的刺出，她观摩数剑，眼中逐渐变得明亮。
这几日，她也在修炼云水剑诀，她天资聪颖，云水剑诀中的精要已掌握得七七八八，只是其中一招‘翻云覆雨’并未掌握其要义，忽见春雨沿着少年木剑疾行，飘落如大珠小珠，细微之处藏剑中精要。
不正是她无法领悟的剑招吗？
“原来是这样！”
莫晚云面露脸上露出喜色，想要与少年分享喜悦，却见少年双脚在泥泞之中，衣衫浸湿，那一双专注而近乎痴迷的眼神让莫晚云第一次对这少年越发好奇。
她目光微凝。
从云袖中取出几页纸帛，悬在小院的墙上，又取来刚刚悬在头顶的书籍安静阅读。
说来也怪，平日里根本看不进去的书，今日在这春雨惊雷中，反倒觉得有趣，读起来也不犯困。
似这般。
一心练剑的少年，手捧圣贤书的豆蔻少女，就在小院中消磨时间。
春雨没有停的迹象，反倒越发下得大了。
少年终于完成今日目标，转身发现一双眼睛正隔着一本书盯着自己。
“喂，小泥鳅，你识字吗？”
顾余生走进木屋，换衣服，隔着一面墙，从窗探出半个脑袋，认真的说道：“认识一些。”
“真的假的？”
“真的。”
顾余生再次说道，他指了指那桌子旁的小木虎。
“我以往天天在上面认字。”
“是吗？”
莫晚云嘴角微扬，随手把手中书放进一个漂亮的储物行囊，换了一本陈旧泛黄的书籍。

等顾余生出来，她翻开书籍的第一页，用手指了指，说道：“这个字，认得吗？”
content_en:
Under the eaves, Mo Wanyun looked curiously at this secluded courtyard. The courtyard was much better than she had imagined. There was a well, a spiritual field, and most importantly, a very cute little wooden tiger.
"Ha, I'm sitting on the Cerebellar Axe!"
Mo Wanyun was immediately attracted by the cute four-legged wooden tiger. He jumped on it and shook the horns on the wooden tiger's head with his two jade hands.
"Little loach, this is fun."
Gu Yusheng looked at Miss Mo on the small wooden tiger, and cautiously approached to protect her.
"Be careful, don't break it."
Mo Wanyun snorted coldly.
"Stingy."
Gu Yusheng did not explain, turned around and walked into the house, placed a few peach blossom cakes in a bamboo basket, took a cup of peach blossom honey soaked in a bamboo tube, walked to Xiao Muhu, and asked:
"Miss Mo, do you want to eat?"
Mo Wanyun nodded, took a bite of the peach blossom cake, choked a little, picked up the peach blossom honey stuffing, took a sip, and wiped his mouth with his small hand.
"Hey, Gu Yusheng, this is what you treat guests with."
Gu Yusheng took a piece of cake from the bamboo basket, chewed it carefully, and said, "This is the best here. Of course, Miss Mo is a rich person, so naturally she can't get used to it. Fortunately, you are not me, so you don't have to suffer like this."
Finished.
Gu Yusheng grasped the wooden sword tightly again and stabbed it at the peach blossom in the small courtyard.
Mo Wanyun pursed his lips and looked at the back of the young man with his sword in the rain for a while. He pursed his lips and looked back, staring at the peach blossom cake and peach blossom honey brew in his hands.
She wanted to tell the boy that the cake and honey wine were both good.
But when she saw that the young man was concentrating, she was left out in the cold. She put down the cake in her hand angrily and muttered: "Do you have to practice swordplay like this? It's raining."
The young man turned back and said with a smile: "I'm used to it. If I miss one sword today, I'll have to punish myself with a hundred swords tomorrow. Calculating this way, it's more cost-effective to complete it every day. Miss Mo, please feel free to do it."
"Boring."
Mo Wanyun saw the slanting rain blowing on the young man's stubborn face, and every sword in his hand was not thrust out perfunctorily. She watched the swords several times, and her eyes gradually became brighter.
In the past few days, she has also been practicing the Yunshui Sword Art. She is very talented and has mastered the essence of the Yunshui Sword Art. However, she has not mastered the essence of one of the moves, "Turn Clouds and Rain". Suddenly, she saw the spring rain running along the young man's wooden sword, falling like big beads and small beads. The essence of the sword is hidden in the subtleties.
Isn't it a sword move that she can't understand?
"So that's it!"
Mo Wanyun's face was filled with joy, and he wanted to share the joy with the boy, but he saw the boy's feet in the mud and his clothes soaked. His focused and almost obsessed eyes made Mo Wanyun more and more curious about this boy for the first time.
Her eyes narrowed slightly.
He took out a few pages of paper from Yunxiu and hung them on the wall of the small courtyard. He also took the book that was just hanging above his head and read quietly.
Strangely enough, a book that I couldn't read at all on weekdays, today in this spring rain and thunder, I found it interesting and I didn't feel sleepy while reading it.
Something like this.
The young man who devoted himself to practicing swordsmanship and the cardamom girl holding the sage's book were killing time in the small courtyard.
The spring rain showed no sign of stopping, but instead became heavier.
The boy finally completed his goal for the day and turned around to find a pair of eyes staring at him through a book.
"Hey, little loach, do you know how to read?"
Gu Yusheng walked into the wooden house, changed his clothes, stuck his head half out of the window through a wall, and said seriously: "Get to know some."
"Really or not?"
"Really."
Gu Yusheng said again, pointing to the little wooden tiger beside the table.
"I used to read on it every day."
"Really?"
Mo Wanyun raised the corner of his mouth slightly, put the book in his hand into a beautiful storage bag, and replaced it with an old and yellowed book.
When Gu Yusheng came out, she opened the first page of the book, pointed with her finger, and said, "Do you recognize this word?"
